summary: Bush-backed gravel kerb and angle bays by Witton Road, no homes close.
reasons: Cars park here; gravel bays alongside

best_section.where: West side of Witton Road at the gravel angle bays opposite the canoe club's north end

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind to the west; nearest dwellings over 50 m; the canoe club is 17 m away across the road and non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel apron and angle bays at the kerb give room to pull fully off the lane; cars parked in both images.
drivers.traffic: Moderately busy road near the Witton Road bridge; the van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P Angle, so a four-hour limit applies; other cars use the bays.

flags: Low-lying: 6 to 9 m elevation, Witton Creek 9 m away, flood-prone
Slope 0.3% on the best section; the first 10 m climbs steeply
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the west edge from the west; open to the sun from the east and north.
rubbish: Some clutter on the gravel apron in QLD imagery; unclear in Esri.
cannot_judge: Whether the 4P limit is enforced overnight
